ex.en: Pedestrians can use the underpass to get to the other side.
ex.zh: 行人可以走地下道到另一邊。

ex.en: The underpass floods when it rains heavily.
ex.zh: 下大雨時地下道會淹水。

ex.en: He was found lying unconscious on the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 他被人發現倒在廚房的地板上，不省人事。

ex.en: She was knocked unconscious by the fall.
Biting her nails was an unconscious habit.
ex.zh: 咬指甲是她無意識的習慣。

ex.en: Many of our decisions are shaped by unconscious bias.
ex.zh: 我們很多決定都受到潛意識偏見的影響。
